queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE (name LIKE 'RealVNC Viewer %' OR name LIKE 'RealVNC Connect Viewer %') AND publisher = 'RealVNC';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE ((name LIKE 'RealVNC Viewer %' OR name LIKE 'RealVNC Connect Viewer %') AND publisher = 'RealVNC') AND version_compare(version, '8.5.0.21') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('rvncconnect.exe','vncviewer.exe'));
